Lares Trek vs Inca Trail: which one to choose in 2026 and why?
Essential comparison of treks to Machu Picchu

If you’re planning to hike to Machu Picchu in 2026, the Inca Trail and the Lares Trek are the top choices. Both are stunning, but the experience depends on what kind of traveler you are.

Inca Trail

The most iconic trek in Peru.

Route: Cusco – Machu Picchu
⏱ Duration: 4 days / 3 nights
Max altitude: 4,215 m
Permits: Limited (book months in advance)

Best if you want:

  • Inca archaeological sites
  • Enter Machu Picchu through the Sun Gate
  • A classic, guided experience

Keep in mind:

  • Sells out fast
  • Mandatory tour operator
  • Crowded in peak season

Lares Trek

A quieter and more nature-focused alternative.

Route: Lares Valley – Ollantaytambo – Machu Picchu
⏱ Duration: 3–4 days
Max altitude: ~4,400 m
Highlight: Natural hot springs

Best if you want:

  • Fewer crowds
  • Authentic Andean culture
  • Hot springs and relaxation
  • Flexible dates (no permits)

Keep in mind:

  • No Inca ruins along the trail
  • Higher altitude sections

Best time to go

April – October (dry season)
Best weather for trekking and views

Top months: April, May, September

Which one should you choose in 2026?

Choose the Inca Trail for history and tradition.
Choose Lares for nature, serenity, and hot springs.
